values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753538 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0', 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753538 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 28ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753538 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists picnic tables, fire rings, campsites, a toilet, drinking water and a concrete boat ramp.

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Big Hole River with designated camping, 23 miles northeast of Wisdom on MT-43. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, the 28-ft trailer limit, the 7-day stay limit (now recorded in booking), drinking water, tables, fire rings, toilet and concrete ramp. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note trimmed of restated facilities, limits, FCFS and fees.
